roles.title: INT recovery project policy
roles.existing_read_dependency: resourcemanager.projects.getIamPolicy is already in captured roles/browser; no duplicate new permission
roles.residual: Project-wide policy modification and custom-role creation can delegate broader authority; TTL is not containment against a principal able to edit its own project policy.

roles.title: INT recovery logging configuration
roles.residual: Create permissions apply to project/location parents. These do not constrain every new log resource name or grant log payload access. Any update/delete action is outside this delta. View SetIamPolicy can delegate log-reading privileges on project views even though this role has no direct log-entry read permission. This delegation ability needs explicit owner review.

roles.title: INT recovery secret containers
roles.residual: Secret Create is checked on the project parent; name restrictions on an absent Secret are not asserted. Only the two reviewed containers are intended; no versions or payload.

roles.title: INT recovery two new secret policies
roles.residual: Policy write can delegate secret payload privileges on only these two new containers. Existing password-secret bindings must remain NO-OP imports; no additional direct SetIamPolicy grant on either existing password secret.

roles.title: INT recovery fixed VM IAP policy
roles.residual: Policy administration only on observed immutable VM instance ID1670495097211408131; a recreated same-name VM is outside the grant. Policy write can delegate tunnel rights; no direct accessViaIAP grant is made to Terraform.

roles.title: INT recovery PostgreSQL SA policy
roles.residual: Policy administration of this SA can delegate impersonation/actAs; role grants neither token creation nor new actAs directly.

provider_operations.scope: projects/clipforgebeta2 (whole project IAM policy; storage.googleapis.com auditConfigs entry)
provider_operations.note: Read-modify-write preserves other entries and writes bindings,etag,auditConfigs; create/update and removal all use same policy methods. Post-write verification reads policy repeatedly.

provider_operations.create_update: POST projects/clipforgebeta2/roles; PATCH projects/clipforgebeta2/roles/clipforgeIntBootstrapReader when definition changes
provider_operations.write_permission: iam.roles.create; iam.roles.update only for a reviewed update
provider_operations.note: Create first performs Get; active preexisting role causes explicit import-required error. Soft-deleted role instead enters Undelete branch: not authorized automatically. Read and deletion-policy-only update also perform Get.

provider_operations.scope: projects/clipforgebeta2 (binding custom bootstrap reader to deploy SA)
provider_operations.note: IAM member Create and Delete both read-modify-write policy; no independent binding create/delete API. The four permissions inside the role are not additional API calls made by the role resource.

provider_operations.create_update: POST projects/clipforgebeta2/locations/us-central1/buckets:createAsync?bucketId=clipforge-int-access; PATCH bucket path for retention/description/locked; POST bucket:updateAsync only if analytics is changed
provider_operations.write_permission: logging.buckets.create; logging.buckets.update only for a reviewed update; logging.operations.get to poll asynchronous creation/update
provider_operations.note: Create performs a GET first; if found, provider enters Update (acquire-or-create semantics). Operation poll GET is projects/P/locations/L/operations/operation-id. HCL has retention30, no analytics/CMEK/lock change request.

provider_operations.write_permission: logging.sinks.create; logging.sinks.update only for a reviewed update
provider_operations.note: Create performs GET then creates or updates found sink. deletion_policy-only Update calls Read (Get), not Patch. Same-project log-bucket destination is automatically authorized: no writer SA creation, actAs, logEntries write or destination IAM grant is required by this HCL.

provider_operations.create_update: POST bucket/views?viewId=pilot-access; PATCH view path if filter/description changes
provider_operations.write_permission: logging.views.create; logging.views.update only for a reviewed update
provider_operations.note: Metadata Read does not query log entries. deletion_policy-only Update calls Read without Patch.
TF principal reads/writes configuration policy only. Granted viewAccessor targets owner; Terraform does not need views.access or privateLogEntries.list to install it.

provider_operations.create_update: POST projects/clipforgebeta2/secrets?secretId=secret-id; PATCH projects/clipforgebeta2/secrets/secret-id only for metadata update
provider_operations.write_permission: secretmanager.secrets.create; secretmanager.secrets.update only for a reviewed metadata update
provider_operations.note: Containers and metadata only. No AddSecretVersion/GetSecretVersion/AccessSecretVersion/ListSecretVersions call in this resource. prevent_destroy remains HCL control.

provider_operations.scope: Only secrets clipforge-int-pg-app-password, clipforge-int-pg-migrator-password, clipforge-int-postgres-ca, clipforge-int-bootstrap-admin in clipforgebeta2
provider_operations.note: No payload read/write required for Terraform. secretAccessor and secretVersionAdder are grants to runtime/deploy principals, not permissions Terraform invokes to configure those policies.
Configures osAdminLogin grant for deploy SA. It does not need to invoke SSH/OS Login or create login keys. No compute operation waiter is called by this IAM updater.

provider_operations.scope: Logical fixed VM in project816643438938/zoneus-central1-a; provider constructs projects/clipforgebeta2/iap_tunnel/zones/us-central1-a/instances/clipforge-int-base-postgres (IAP docs canonical example uses project number)
provider_operations.note: Configures tunnel access policy. No accessViaIAP or actual tunnel opening needed for the Terraform policy operation; no project lookup/list to resolve VM in this updater.
